source: Measured 2026-10-14 from the development Mac that ran the captured agent: TCP connect (one network round trip), TLS handshake and time to first byte, median of 5 samples per host (scratchpad probe.py). Locations: OpenAI and Cartesia report their edge in response headers (Cloudflare colo YYZ, CloudFront POP YTO50); Deepgram and LiveKit Cloud send none, so their IPs were located with ipinfo.io. The agent's location is approximate, from the machine's time zone (America/Toronto). An edge is where the connection lands, not necessarily where the model runs; the inference region is not exposed. Deepgram re-measured 2026-10-15 against its Virginia host after DNS moved it there; the earlier Santa Clara reading was 88.9 ms.

endpoints.located: DNS name api.va1.deepgram.com (va1 = Virginia), seen by traceroute on 2026-10-15. api.deepgram.com also resolves to sv1 (Silicon Valley).
endpoints.measured: 2026-10-15, TCP connect median of 12 samples to api.va1.deepgram.com, range 40 to 139 ms; TLS and first byte median of 7
